subject.title: fix(session): stop repeated restart recovery after retry budget

question: Do maintainers accept three cumulative accepted main-session recovery attempts, with tombstoning before the fourth dispatch and reset only after successful progress or session replacement?
rationale: The exact-head implementation has a coherent three-attempt cumulative policy, but that policy intentionally changes operator-visible recovery behavior and the live PR description still states the earlier two-attempt boundary.

options.title: Approve three cumulative attempts
options.body: Keep the exact-head implementation and align the PR body and proof narrative before merge.

options.title: Return to two attempts
options.body: Lower the ceiling and update the tests and design plan to match the current PR description’s faster quarantine policy.

options.title: Use a timed window
options.body: Reset the main recovery budget after elapsed time, accepting weaker protection against slow supervisor restart loops.

recommendation.title: Approve three cumulative attempts
recommendation.body: Keep the exact-head implementation and align the PR body and proof narrative before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the assigned member, current-head author, and author of the finalized recovery policy and design plan.
